title: HATEPRISM: Policies, Platforms, and Research Integration. Advancing NLP for Hate Speech Proactive Mitigation
reasoning: The paper conducts a systematic survey and comparative analysis of hate speech definitions and regulations, which are fundamentally ethical and moral issues. It specifically examines religion as a protected category and a target of hate speech (e.g., Islamophobia) and queries whether research datasets record the religious background of annotators. It also explores philosophical/ethical concepts like freedom of speech versus harmful speech mitigation.
